tier_reason: C stands: the only head-to-head is a 2023 EMQ-run test of VerneMQ 1.12.6.2 (current 2.2.1).

corrections.caveats: Enricher: the sustained-rate win is multi-core VerneMQ against Mosquitto using about one core (6% of 16 vCPU); 50k/s is offered load, not a measured ceiling. The 1M-connection average win comes only from Mosquitto's p99 tail: p50-p90 are equal at 2 ms and VerneMQ's p95 is worse (3 vs 2 ms). VerneMQ's default max_online_messages and max_offline_messages of 1000 drop excess messages per session, and the post does not say whether drops occurred in the fan-out runs. Official binaries and Docker images need a paid subscription for commercial use. Memory growth issues #2130 (closed for inactivity) and #2395 (open) were never root-caused; 2.2.0 regressed webhook latency about 20x (#2534, fixed in 2.2.1).
